justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/assembly/{AbstractAssemblyParser.java,AssemblyUtil.java,AssemblyReference.java,AssemblyProcessor.java,AssemblyMethod.java,AssemblyBlock.java,AssemblyInstruction.java,AssemblyLabels.java,Architecture.java,IAssemblyParser.java} and the direct subpackage classes in model/assembly/arm and model/assembly/x86. The package has broad fan-in from parser/model/UI code (e.g. HotSpotLogParser.java, Compilation.java, AbstractMetaMember.java, IMetaMember.java, TriView.java, ViewerAssembly.java, AssemblyLabel.java, OSUtil.java, DisassemblyUtil.java), but it also directly depends on the more implementation-specific arm/x86 subpackages via AssemblyUtil.java and AbstractAssemblyParser.java, and on MnemonicEntry via AssemblyReference.java. Those subpackages have much smaller external fan-in and depend back on this package, so the target package is depending on less stable packages.
